title: News dates put back on the calendar
summary:
A housekeeping day: corrected news dates, repaired documentation links, and refreshed supporter lists.

Corrected the website news dates for the Special Bee request and API documentation entries to March 28, 2025, and updated README Latest News to point to both.

Special Bee request links now point to the GitHub issue form rather than its template file. React Hooks links now point to the README and playground; the README also received a few presentation updates.

Updated the website and README supporter lists. The README now names Cloudflare, Scaleway, and Modal, with LLMPlayground.net also included in its supporter-logo image.
